decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no milestone despite welcome email [email:69648c71], nudge [email:6e506272], and a held onboarding call [calendar:3476ee27] with zero customer reply or ticket activity. Team plan and attended call suggest some intent, but silence after three touches points to low unaided odds in 8 days.

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

Thanks again for making time for the onboarding call last week. Since then I wanted to check in on getting your workspace moving.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating your first one is the step that unlocks the rest. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Chidi
